name: Pixel Buds
author: Ryan Doupe
description: Pixel Buds Pro in the Omarchy bar — battery per bud and case, listening modes, shared volume with swipe OSD, touch gestures, and device + sound controls (multipoint, speech detection, on-head, EQ, balance). Event-driven: the icon appears the moment your buds connect. Needs pbpctrl (AUR); the popup walks you through installing it if missing.

barWidget.description: Battery, listening modes, shared volume with swipe OSD, touch gestures, and advanced sound controls. Needs pbpctrl (AUR).
